title: implement padding

atoms.evidence: pad1d: output = x.new_full(size=(B, C, left+W+right), fill_value=pad_value); output[..., left:left+W] = x — allocate fresh tensor filled with pad_value, copy input into the middle. pad2d does the 2D version.

atoms_in_seed_but_not_actually_present.reason: seed predicted broadcasting for exercise 20 but pad1d/pad2d are pure indexed-copy operations; no broadcasting fires

notes: 1-atom exercise — the most concentrated atom firing yet. pad1d and pad2d are essentially the same atom at two arities; both are pure indexed-copy with new_full. Note the gotcha called out in the hint dropdown: '[..., left:-right]' fails when right=0 — pedagogically important but not an atom on its own. Below the 4-7 band but appropriate for a deliberately-isolated foundational utility.
